## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive — weak/narrow. VXX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -21.42%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Cyclical vs Defensive (Level ↑ rising) confirm risk appetite but weak breadth forces a CAUTION call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -21.42%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit signal mixed: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.25%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.62% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND while HYG/LQD flagged stress in the regime inputs.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive. SPY/TLT (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +2.49%) ↓ falling CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +1.01% | 1M: -0.39%) RECOVERY show bond demand; Dollar UUP (1W: +0.11% | 1M: -1.44%) → flat RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +8.98%) showing strength while XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -1.50% | 1M: +0.75%) and XLF in CORRECTION (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +5.78%) lag on the week; style: cyclicals over growth.

5. US vs Global?
US modestly mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.78% | 1M: +2.09%) while Europe shows resilience via FEZ CORRECTION (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +4.83%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.16% | 1M: -1.24%) signals China weakness; EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.51% | 1M: +0.21%).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed-to-cooling: IWM CORRECTION (1W: -1.70% | 1M: +6.90%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -2.11% | 1M: +5.78%) show rotation, while IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -5.46%) BELOW TREND indicates crypto risk-off.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals leadership: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +27.71%) and GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +6.30%) with CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +6.84%) supporting industrial demand.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing weakness: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -1.80%), BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -7.20%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -18.16%) all under pressure.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
MAJOR divergence present: SPY, XLK, XLF and TLT show 1W vs 1M mismatches indicating transitional internals; CONFIRMED commodity strength via SLV and GLD ABOVE TREND, but equity leadership is unstable so keep risk selective.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals exposure (XLY ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit-curve signals; reduce exposure to XLK (CORRECTION) and watch IBIT (BELOW TREND) and energy ETFs for continued weakness, while bonds (TLT RECOVERY) and gold (GLD ABOVE TREND) provide ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +8.98%) — if breadth expands. BEARISH: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -1.80%) — watch further downside.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +27.71%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +6.84%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -18.16%) and BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -7.20%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~25–30 (fear marker) with VXX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -21.42%) BELOW TREND; HYG/LQD watch band ~0.75–0.80 for credit health; Tech/Fin pivot XLK/XLF ratio ~2.60 (current 2.5952) to signal rotation; SPY/TLT at 7.6680 (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +2.49%) CORRECTION to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and VXX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -21.42%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND with cyclicals showing strength but narrow internals. XLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +8.98%) and metals SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +27.71%) showing relative strength; major 1W/1M divergences across SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT are the key risk to monitor.
